task: Independent non-author review of the twelve private GitHub-art candidate bundles authored by github_art_integration.
scope: Audited all twelve candidate bundles against their declared immediate parent and public prerequisite, independently restored each bundle into a temporary bare repository, checked current public pull-request refs and stable repository IDs, verified exact five-file art scope and the website full-delta boundary, validated receipt metadata and README/profile picture links, compared all 36 target PNGs byte-for-byte with canonical revision 40b0c07796b24e029fbee3bf913b5869cb61fe35, and checked all thirteen social-preview records plus the root-owned GH-13 README picture. No source edit, commit, push, generation, merge, rename, or GitHub Settings mutation occurred.

findings.title: GH-11 bundle head parent and declared immediate delta disagree

actual_commit_chain_from_public_prerequi.subject: Add private GitHub art candidate GH11

findings.evidence: The bundle restores to 40bcb9516. Its direct parent is d6b70237, while the map/result declare e5153d662 as immediate_parent and list five immediate files. The d6b70237 commit adds the README and three PNGs plus the receipt; the 40bcb951 commit changes only the receipt. The public-prerequisite-to-head tree still has the declared five files, so the final content and PNG checks pass while the direct-parent contract fails.
findings.impact: The authored result claim of 12/12 exact five-file immediate deltas is false when immediate parent means the bundle head parent. GH-11 cannot be approved under the requested exact-parent and exact-scope review.
findings.required_action: Rebuild or re-bundle GH-11 with a final candidate head whose direct parent is e5153d662 and whose direct-parent delta is exactly the five declared files, or explicitly revise the candidate contract to represent the two-commit sequence and obtain a fresh independent review.

website_full_delta_boundary.interpretation: The five-file immediate delta is the GitHub-art candidate. The 46-file public-prerequisite delta includes the earlier reviewed website candidate between public PR#1 head and this art candidate parent; it is inherited history and is not claimed as this candidate’s five-file change.

social_preview.scope: Thirteen reviewed image candidates prepared privately for manual GitHub social-preview settings. No upload or settings change has occurred.
social_preview.publication_boundary: All records remain prepared_not_applied with publication_approved false; no GitHub Settings upload occurred.

gh13_root_readme.reason: Root README is root-owned per the integration boundary.
gh13_root_readme.interpretation: The working root README points to the canonical local GH-13 light/dark banner files and provides non-empty alt text. The GH-13 social record and all canonical source hashes/dimensions are consistent. No GH-13 target-repository integration was performed or approved.

decision.follow_up: Repair the GH-11 bundle/metadata direct-parent mismatch, then rerun this independent review before treating the complete twelve-candidate set as review-passed.

limitations: This review checks repository artifacts and local canonical bytes; it does not upload social previews, merge pull requests, deploy a site, or inspect a live GitHub preview crop.
The canonical source revision is committed locally and unpushed, so publication remains separately gated.
The root-owned GH-13 README was checked for local consistency and intentionally excluded from target-repository integration review.
